title: Understanding AWS Account Information
objectives: Identify the AWS account ID associated with a user's session.
List the AWS regions available in an account.

mission_brief.situation: As a cloud operator, you need to understand how to access and manage your AWS account information.
mission_brief.mission: Identify the AWS account ID associated with a user's session and list the available regions in an account.
mission_brief.execution: Use the AWS CLI to retrieve account information.

content.concept: Account information is essential for managing and securing your AWS account.
content.walkthrough: This lesson will guide you through using the AWS CLI to retrieve account information.
checkpoints: Verify the AWS CLI version installed on your system.
Check the AWS account ID associated with a user's session.
common_mistakes: Using an incorrect AWS profile or region.

interrogation_questions: What is the purpose of retrieving AWS account information?
How do you verify the AWS CLI version installed on your system?

resume_bullets: Identified the AWS account ID associated with a user's session.
Listed the available regions in an account.
